items.title: How enabling two settings tripled our scores on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark

items.title: A scorecard for the AI age
items.content: Sarah Friar, CFO of OpenAI, introduces a practical AI scorecard to measure ROI through useful work, cost per successful task, dependability, and return on compute.
items.contentSnippet: Sarah Friar, CFO of OpenAI, introduces a practical AI scorecard to measure ROI through useful work, cost per successful task, dependability, and return on compute.

summaries.zh: OpenAI首席财务官莎拉·弗莱尔提出了一套面向人工智能时代的实用评估计分卡，用于衡量投资回报率。该计分卡围绕四个核心维度：有效完成的工作量、每次成功任务的成本、系统的可靠性与可信度，以及计算资源的投入产出比，旨在为企业部署AI提供清晰的效益评估框架。
summaries.en: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar has introduced a practical AI scorecard to measure return on investment. The framework assesses performance through four metrics: useful work, cost per successful task, dependability, and return on compute. It is designed to help organizations evaluate AI effectiveness beyond simple productivity gains.
